title: D-2 manifest filtering and D-3 local selection exemption

acceptance.retiredClones: buildSkills pass 1 skips a user-layer clone whose sidecar sourceRef is skills-sh:<retired root id>, in every selection mode (absent, all, explicit allowlist). Missing/malformed sidecar or bare 'skills-sh:' retires nothing (fail-open).
acceptance.retiredOverlay: An overlay path that IS a retired root contributes no skills and no commands (covers the gap until Batch 26 skips retired ids in the loader).
acceptance.workspaceExemption: New HarnessManifestBuildOptions.workspaceRoot. Only ptah-skillssh-* roots whose parent is workspacePluginsDir(workspaceRoot) bypass the skillSync selection; disabledSkillIds/disabledPluginIds still apply. Other workspaces, global skills.sh roots, harness and bundled plugins stay gated. No workspaceRoot = nothing exempt.
acceptance.retiredInput: Builder reads sources.retired itself (decision #56); absent = nothing retired.
tests: [D-2] a clone whose sourceRef names a retired skills.sh root is inactive under absent, all and an explicit selection of its slug; other refs stay
[D-2] absent or empty retired sources retire nothing, and a prefix-only or malformed sidecar fails open (decision #56)
[D-2] an overlay path that IS a retired root contributes no skills or commands; a live global skills.sh root still does
[D-D4] workspace skills.sh roots bypass the selection: an empty selection in workspace A keeps only A's skills.sh skills, sourced from A; B gets only B's
[D-D4] other overlays stay subject to the selection
[D-D4] without a workspaceRoot nothing is exempt
[D-D4] the exempt root still honours disabledSkillIds and disabledPluginIds
[D-D4] a bundled plugin outside the enabled overlay keeps its user-layer clone gated per workspace

decisions: Set-based skills-sh sourceRef match instead of shared isRetiredSourceRef(ref, registry): the resolver passes retired root dirs, not the registry; same rule (prefix + exact root id).
Retired overlay skip also covers commands.
risks: Exemption compares path.resolve output (case-sensitive); the loader must build workspace overlay paths with workspacePluginsDir from the same normalized root.
deriveSourceRoots still lists a retired overlay path as a source root (containment only).
